subject: Infrastructure Loan Overruns and Replica Handgun Ban
overview: The Council tabled several capital improvement loan orders following debates over remediation cost overruns and building defects at the new public works facility. They also approved a resolution to develop a local ordinance banning replica handguns in public spaces.

items.title: Ceremonial Matters and Minutes
items.summary: The Council held a moment of silence for victims of the Paris terrorist attacks and approved the minutes of the November 10 meeting.

items.title: Brooks Estate Updates
items.summary: The Council kept the Carriage House loan order in committee while requesting reports on capital improvement expenditures, road upgrade requirements from the fire chief, and a sewage system mitigation plan.

items.title: DPW Facility Loan Order
items.summary: The Council tabled a $300,000 borrowing request for the new facility, ordering a report on building defects like roof leaks and requesting that the city solicitor investigate legal recourse for inaccurate soil remediation estimates.

items.title: Winthrop Street Drainage Project
items.summary: A $350,000 loan order for project cost overruns was tabled pending a detailed written breakdown of expenses related to police details and engineering errors.

items.title: Replica Handgun Ordinance
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution to meet with the police chief and city solicitor to craft an ordinance banning replica handguns in public places.

items.title: George and Main Street Pedestrian Controls
items.summary: A request for implementation of pedestrian crossing controls at the intersection was approved and referred to the Pedestrian Committee.

items.title: Medford Square Bus Stop Relocations
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting a meeting and written report from MassDOT and the MBTA regarding bus stop relocations during Cradock Bridge construction.

items.title: Chevalier Auditorium Management
items.summary: Concerns regarding the dismissal of the auditorium's booking agent and building manager were referred to the Arts and Culture Subcommittee for further review.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Report
items.summary: The Council received and placed on file a report detailing the opening of new medical centers and an expansion of operating room hours at the hospital.

items.title: School Safety Meeting Request
items.summary: Councilors discussed a recent school break-in and the ongoing attempt to schedule a joint meeting with the School Committee regarding security protocols.
